description: PG1 Sovereign Threat Intelligence: returns a STIX 2.1 bundle of CVE records from NIST NVD, the only source PG1 may currently redistribute commercially. Today it contains no IP, domain, URL or file-hash indicators: every object is a STIX vulnerability with the CVE id and an NVD reference, without scores (use get_cve_details for CVSS and known-exploited status). FREE (CVE records from NIST NVD); does not use the 5 free paid calls a day; no payment, no licence key (the operator's PG1_FEED_PAID switch can make it paid). SIBLING DIFFERENTIATION: Use ONLY for bulk feed synchronizations. Do NOT use for single-item lookups (use get_ioc_context) or CVE analysis (use get_cve_details). USAGE EXCLUSIONS: Does not provide historical query archival beyond the active ingestion window. BEHAVIOR: Pagination is handled via the limit parameter (max 1000).

limit.description: Pagination boundary constraint defining the maximum number of indicators to return in a single payload (integer between 1 and 1000, defaulting to 500).

min_score.description: Confidence score threshold integer ranging inclusively from 0 to 100 to filter low-confidence noise.

since.description: ISO timestamp constraint (e.g., 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z); strictly filters and returns only indicators last seen after this exact timestamp.

type.description: Indicator category filter. Allowed enum-style values: 'IPv4', 'domain', 'URL', 'FileHash-MD5', 'FileHash-SHA1', or 'FileHash-SHA256'.

name: get_threat_indicators
